description.value: A large 127-site BC Parks campground on the sandy shores of warm Cowichan Lake, set in one of Vancouver Island's sunniest valleys with a full suite of amenities including showers. Access via paved Hwy 18 and 14 km on South Shore Road makes it straightforward for loaded bikes.

address.value: 7370 Walton Rd, Honeymoon Bay, BC V0R 1Y0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as a BC Parks campground operated by K2 Cowichan Park Services Ltd., confirmed active via the official BC Parks website. The website prominently features a 'Book camping' button and a 'Reservation policies' section listing frontcountry and group camping, confirming reservations are accepted. Most specific amenity details (showers, potable water, hiker/biker sites, etc.) are not addressed in the fetched website text, which focuses on activities and location rather than facility inventory.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Gordon Bay Campground' but the official BC Parks website consistently refers to the property as 'Gordon Bay Park'.

Phone number (+1-877-559-2115) and email (k2cowichan@shaw.ca) are attributed to operator K2 Cowichan Park Services Ltd. in OSM; the fetched website page does not display contact details to cross-verify.

Facility-level amenity details (showers, potable water, hiker/biker sites, etc.) are absent from the fetched page content; a more detailed BC Parks facilities page or direct confirmation would be needed to populate these fields.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC Parks campground with 127 sites on Cowichan Lake; reservations confirmed. A well-established overnight option on a southern Vancouver Island cycling route.
enrichment_extras.notes: The OSM tag internet_access=no was noted but not used to infer device-charging status, as these are distinct amenities.
